Kanzi Windows smoke test (Parallels VM)

COPY THESE 3 FILES INTO THE VM:
- My Clippings.txt
- kanzi-dummy.epub
- kanzi-dummy.pdf
- dist/kanzi.xpi (from repo root, same cross-platform build)

1) PowerShell:
   winget install --id Python.Python.3.13 --exact
   winget install --id oschwartz10612.Poppler --exact
   winget install --id QPDF.QPDF --exact
   python --version
   pdftotext -v
   pdfinfo -v
   qpdf --version

2) Fully quit + reopen Zotero (picks up PATH).

3) Fresh Zotero, sync off. Create:
   - Book "Kanzi Dummy EPUB" + attach kanzi-dummy.epub
   - Book "Kanzi Dummy PDF" + attach kanzi-dummy.pdf

4) Tools -> Kanzi -> Choose My Clippings.txt (the copied one).
   Leave Python path empty to test auto-detect.

EXPECT:
- 2 highlights position and await review, 1 title in Conflicts
  ("Unknown Book Title XYZ").
- Summary shows new Status by Kindle Title table with source counts.
- Save a mapping for the unknown title -> Re-import processes it.
- Table headers sort and persist across pages.

IF PYTHON NOT FOUND:
  Settings shows detected path hint; paste full python.exe path,
  Save Settings, retry.
